proc_pickles_top_desc: We rank among the top pickled-food producers in Korea with HACCP certification and rigorous hygiene. Metal detectors and X-ray inspection control metallic foreign matter as well as stones, ceramics, and similar contaminants.
proc_step01_desc: This is a process that minimizes damage to raw materials and thoroughly and hygienically cleans even the smallest foreign substances using three-stage air bubbles.
proc_step02_desc: This is a process that secures uniform and high quality raw materials by first filtering out raw materials that do not meet specifications or are damaged.
proc_step03_desc: This is a process in which workers check the raw materials more precisely and ultimately select only the highest quality raw materials for the table.
proc_step04_desc: This is a process that creates a deep, rich taste by mixing carefully selected raw materials with Eum Food System Co., Ltd.’s special seasoning in precise proportions.
proc_step05_desc: This is a process in which finished products are placed in the correct quantity in a strictly hygienic (HACCP) environment and sealed to completely block external contamination.
proc_step06_desc: This is a safety process that strictly inspects the standard weight and completely filters out fine metallic contaminants using a metal detector.
proc_step07_desc: This is a flawless verification process that thoroughly controls non-metallic contaminants such as stones and ceramics that are difficult to see with the naked eye using state-of-the-art X-ray equipment.

facility_status_main_tit: Eum Food System Co., Ltd. Facility Status
facility_ga_item_01_desc:
Heats large batches of ingredients at a uniform temperature to bring out their full
flavor and aroma.
facility_ga_item_02_desc:
A high-performance automated system vacuum-packs contents to keep products
fresh for longer.
facility_ga_item_03_desc:
Mixes various ingredients evenly without clumping so every batch delivers a
consistent taste.
facility_ga_item_04_desc:
Generates powerful micro-bubbles to remove foreign matter from every surface of the
raw product without damage.
facility_ga_item_05_desc:
Moves washed ingredients to the next process while continuously managing and
transferring any remaining debris.
facility_ga_item_06_desc:
Sterilizes products with high-temperature water to suppress microbial growth and
improve distribution safety.
facility_ga_item_07_desc:
As ingredients move along the line, unsuitable foreign matter is carefully checked
and accurately removed.
facility_ga_item_08_desc:
Fully removes internal air to prevent oxidation and further improve
shelf stability.
facility_ga_item_09_desc:
At the workshop entrance, strong airflow removes dust and fine particles from clothing
to maintain hygiene.
facility_ga_item_10_desc:
Detects even tiny metal particles that may enter during production to strictly
ensure product safety.
facility_ga_item_11_desc:
Uses X-ray transmission to precisely find and inspect non-metal as well as metal
foreign objects.
facility_ga_item_12_desc:
Tapes boxes containing finished products quickly and securely for safe shipping
to outbound specifications.
facility_item_01_desc: Uniformly blends large batches of ingredients so every product delivers the same consistent taste.
facility_item_02_desc:
High-speed rotation disperses ingredients finely and evenly for a refined particle size and
premium sauce quality.
facility_item_03_desc:
A high-speed rotary system supports mass production with accurate fill volumes and
reliable sealing.
facility_item_04_desc:
Runs two lines at once for small-volume products, improving efficiency and neat
packaging to consistent specs.
facility_item_05_desc:
Hygienically fills various container sizes with sauce and precise dosing to boost
product reliability.
facility_item_06_desc:
A pouch-optimized filling system prevents leaks and fills contents safely and
cleanly.
facility_item_07_desc:
Minimizes damage to raw materials; a three-stage bubble wash removes fine foreign matter
hygienically.
facility_item_08_desc:
Cuts raw product evenly and precisely to preserve texture and visual
appeal.
facility_item_09_desc:
Keeps ingredient-to-brine ratios steady for a crisp bite and fresh flavor as if
just made.
facility_item_10_desc:
At the final stage of production, detects even tiny metal contaminants to ensure
absolute food safety.
facility_item_11_desc:
Securely boxes finished goods to prevent damage in distribution and maximize
line efficiency.

biz_process_overview_main_tit: Eum Food System Co., Ltd. manufacturing process
biz_pf_pk_01d: Incoming raw materials are received and traceability records are created.
biz_pf_pk_02d: Raw materials are checked for condition, specification, and foreign matter before processing.
biz_pf_pk_03d: Soaking conditions are controlled to stabilize texture and quality.
biz_pf_pk_04d: Multi-stage washing removes residual foreign matter hygienically.
biz_pf_pk_05d: Ingredients and seasoning are mixed uniformly for consistent flavor.
biz_pf_pk_06d: Products are filled and sealed according to packaging format for safety and shelf life.
biz_pf_pk_07d: Metal detectors block metallic foreign matter.
biz_pf_pk_08d: X-ray inspection checks non-metallic contaminants such as stone or ceramic.
biz_pf_pk_09d: Final outer packaging is completed before shipment.
biz_pf_br_01d: Raw materials are received and traceability is recorded.
biz_pf_br_02d: Raw materials are inspected against quality and specification criteria.
biz_pf_br_03d: Only materials that meet specification are selected.
biz_pf_br_04d: Heating and braising develop depth of flavor.
biz_pf_br_05d: Inner packaging and sealing preserve hygiene and product integrity.
biz_pf_br_06d: Metal contaminants are detected and rejected.
biz_pf_br_07d: X-ray inspection covers non-metallic foreign matter.
biz_pf_br_08d: Outer packaging and shipment to customers.
biz_pf_pi_02d: Incoming raw materials are checked for quality and conformity.
biz_pf_pi_04d: Washing removes debris and maintains hygiene.
biz_pf_pi_05d: Cutting to size for the next process.
biz_pf_pi_06d: Pickle products are inner-packed and sealed.
biz_pf_sa_01d: Raw and sub-materials are received and checked.
biz_pf_sa_02d: Raw materials are inspected for quality and suitability.
biz_pf_sa_03d: Ingredients are accurately weighed according to formula.
biz_pf_sa_04d: Heating and cooling conditions are controlled to secure quality and safety.
biz_pf_sa_05d: Products are filled and sealed by container type.
